subject: Fluidkey
claim: Users of the Fluidkey privacy wallet report funds drained across seven chains in about 25 minutes, routed through Fluidkey's own relayer with valid signatures. Fluidkey took services offline at 18:05 UTC and is working with SEAL 911. Cause is unconfirmed; supply-chain compromise is speculation pending a post-mortem.

subject: Wagyu XMR1
claim: About $13.5 million in XMR1 sales drove Wagyu's wrapped Monero token from about $500 to $1 on Hyperliquid. Wagyu's operator attributed the incident to an exposed deployer key in a hosting-provider breach; on-chain records corroborate the sales but do not establish how the key was obtained.
